banner: COMMISSIONING ONLY -- RELEASE_FORBIDDEN. Regenerate and re-pin both sides after the six-board schedule measurement; status 3/11 remain unvalidated.
scope: frame layout and validation rules only; the decoder state machine is not covered
comparison_rule: age < T is fresh; age >= T has timed out

validation_pending.STATUS_CLASS_3: min-range-clipped as SENSOR_FAULT: needs the as-mounted floor distance, the rate over a normal floor, and an occlusion injection
validation_pending.STATUS_CLASS_11: merged-pulse as NO_TARGET: needs the rate over a real edge and over plain floor. Frequent on plain floor is a configuration problem
validation_pending.T_meas_max_gap: the profile value is a PLACEHOLDER, not derived from stopping distance

profile_provenance: arithmetic from byte counts at 400 kHz (L4 read 133 B = 3.06 ms, re-arm 2 B = 0.11 ms, four sensors = 12.7 ms of bus time) plus stated design choices. Valid ONLY for four L4 reads and no L7 reads on the bus.

unresolved_for_release.T_cycle_nominal: output of the six-board schedule measurement
unresolved_for_release.T_meas_max_gap: derived from stopping distance, needs the schedule measurement
unresolved_for_release.T_cycle_assembly: bounded by T_skew_max + T_health_delivery_max and T_meas_max_gap
unresolved_for_release.T_health_nominal: output of the acquisition thread design
unresolved_for_release.T_health_max_gap: must exceed T_health_delivery_max, measured under full bus load
unresolved_for_release.T_health_delivery_max: worst-case health latency, measured or analysed on the real bus
unresolved_for_release.T_startup_health_grace: node start + SCB boot + worst-case first heartbeat arrival
unresolved_for_release.T_skew_max: worst-case intra-cycle phase skew across the four sensors
